info.title: LinuxServer Hub API
info.summary: Metadata, builds and generated artefacts for every LinuxServer.io container image.
info.description:
Versions, tags, architectures, changelogs and container parameters for every LinuxServer.io image, every
build with its packages, layers and changes, the mods index, the PRoot Apps index, and compose, Kubernetes,
quadlet and reverse proxy snippets.

Every endpoint is a plain `GET` with no authentication. Fields that have no value are omitted rather than
`null`. Query parameters are not supported: `include_config` and `include_deprecated` are separate files
under Compatibility.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: Resolved base digest at build time (amd64).

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: The hub's package table per architecture; only the newest build of each branch has one. For the others, `sbom` is the build's syft document.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: The build's folder on its image repository's GitHub Pages (`https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>/builds/<tag>/`), with a trailing slash: `files.<arch>.json.gz`, `packages.<arch>.json.gz`, `vulns.json` and each architecture's unpacked test report under `<arch>/` (see `tests.json`). Served with `access-control-allow-origin: *` for the newest 5 builds of each live branch, the builds the hub holds.

files.title: Files
files.description: `files.<arch>.json.gz` per architecture on the repository's Pages (under `pages`): gzip served as `application/gzip`, without `Content-Encoding`.

sbom.title: Sbom
sbom.description: `packages.<arch>.json.gz`, the build's syft document, per architecture on the repository's Pages (under `pages`), served like `files`.

run_json.title: Run Json
run_json.description: `run.json` on the Release: the control plane's record of the workflow run. A download link (Release assets send no CORS headers); 404 for releases made before control attached it.

logs_zip.title: Logs Zip
logs_zip.description: `logs.zip` on the Release: the run's masked log archive. A download link; 404 for releases made before control attached it.

test_report.title: Test Report
test_report.description: The build's CI results page on the website, `<site>/images/<image>/builds/<tag>/` (the hub's own `/builds/<image>/<tag>/` only redirects there).

tests.title: Tests
tests.description: `tests.json`: the harness reports per architecture, when any exist.

vulns.title: Vulns
vulns.description: `vulns.json` on the repository's Pages (under `pages`), for builds that scanned themselves: the scan made when the image was built, never rescanned. `{image, tag, summary, by_arch, matches, db_date, grype_version, scanned_at, caveats}` (CONVENTIONS §6, "Repo Pages"); `summary` is `vulnerabilities`, and `caveats` say how to read the counts. The hub serves no copy.

VulnerabilitySummary.title: VulnerabilitySummary
VulnerabilitySummary.description:
Counts of a build's own vulnerability scan, made when it was built (grype against each architecture's syft SBOM,
with that day's database) and never rescanned: over distinct findings, one per vulnerability id and package across
the architectures. The findings are the build's `vulns.json` on its repository's Pages (`links.vulns`).
